integrity: All-parameter proof supplied using orbit-simplex identification and explicit acyclic face-poset matching; small-case computation corroborates but does not establish general theorem. No external independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Geometric fixed points for layer swap only; no entire equivariant homotopy type, complete character, or homotopy fixed points. Revised motivating manuscript inaccessible in full; originality subject to unindexed literature.
title: Layer-exchange fixed loci of circular-ladder perfect-matching complexes
